description: This file defines the IBasketViewModelService interface, which declares methods related to basket view models in the Web layer of the application.

classes.name: IBasketViewModelService
classes.description: Interface for basket view model operations, including retrieving or creating baskets, counting items, and mapping basket entities.

methods.name: GetOrCreateBasketForUser
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves or creates a basket for the specified user.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously counts total items in the user's basket.

methods.name: Map
methods.description: Maps a Basket entity to a BasketViewModel.
